mods.title: Legs Addon
mods.description: This addon fixes one of the most noticeable visual flaws of the original game — the missing legs of the protagonist. Now, when you look down, you'll see legs that match your selected suit.
mods.author: IX-Ray Team

mods.title: Puddles Addon 2.1
mods.description: The addon contains 3d puddles placed on the locations of the original game Call of Pripyat. Compatible with all mods and does not require adaptations.
mods.author: IX-Ray Team, MSR
